jobs_results.title: Lead Frontend Developer-React + Next
jobs_results.description:
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Front-End Lead Developer to lead front-end engineering for high-traffic, consumer-facing websites built with Next.js and React. This is a hands-on player-coach role accountable for front-end architecture, component quality, accessibility, performance and coordinated delivery across a team of front-end developers.


The ideal candidate combines deep React and Next.js expertise with strong UI engineering craft and production support experience. You will build and review code, set standards, guide estimates, mentor developers, integrate APIs and act as the escalation point for priority front-end issues, supporting both new feature delivery and ongoing operations. Experience with headless CMS platforms such as Contentstack is a strong advantage.


What You'll Do
Lead front-end development on Next.js and React, remaining hands-on with pages, components, routing, data fetching and rendering.
Own the front-end approach, including component architecture, coding standards, branching strategy, review practices and definition of done.
Build and maintain reusable UI components and design-system patterns that deliver pixel-perfect, responsive experiences across modern browsers and devices.
Consume back-end and third-party APIs, handling loading, error and edge states consistently.
Drive performance (Core Web Vitals), accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), SEO and cross-browser quality across all web experiences.
Support Vercel deployment workflows, including preview deployments and production releases, in partnership with the Back-End Lead.
Implement A/B and multivariate tests and analytics integrations with business stakeholders, and permanently implement successful tests.
Act as the escalation point for priority front-end production issues and take part in rotational weekend and holiday support coverage.
Validate estimates, break down work and mentor front-end developers through design reviews, pairing and code reviews.
Ensure adequate automated test coverage (unit, component and end-to-end) in partnership with Quality Engineering.
Apply secure front-end coding practices aligned to OWASP Top 10.
Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve development standards, tooling and performance.
Required Skills & Experience
Front-End Engineering
5-8 years of professional front-end development on customer-facing websites, including 2+ years in a lead developer role.
Expert JavaScript and TypeScript, React (hooks, state management, component design), HTML5 and CSS (Sass or LESS).
Strong Next.js experience, including App Router and Pages Router, SSR, SSG, ISR and React Server Components.
Experience consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
Working knowledge of Vercel or a similar front-end hosting and deployment platform.
Quality, Performance & Accessibility
Strong knowledge of Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse and front-end performance optimisation.
Solid understanding of accessibility standards and compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA).
Experience planning and delivering solutions across multiple browsers and devices.
Testing experience with Jest, React Testing Library and Playwright or Cypress; component-driven development with Storybook.
Leadership & Delivery
Proven ability to lead developers, uphold engineering standards and take accountability for team output.
Experience validating estimates and planning technical delivery in Agile teams with Git-based workflows and pull-request governance.
Experience supporting production websites, including incident triage and root-cause analysis.
Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client teams.
Nice to Have
Experience with headless CMS platforms, ideally Contentstack (content models, modular blocks, live preview and publishing workflows).
Experience with A/B testing and analytics platforms such as Adobe Target, Optimizely, Adobe Analytics or Google Analytics 4.
Experience establishing design systems and UI component libraries.
Experience migrating websites from a traditional CMS (such as Sitecore) to a headless architecture.
Familiarity with .NET back-end services and PCI-compliant development.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot.
What We're Looking For
Player-coach who leads by example in code quality, reviews and delivery discipline.
Craftsperson who cares about pixel-perfect, accessible and fast user interfaces.
Calm and accountable during production incidents.
Mentor who helps developers grow in skill and autonomy.
Client-focused communicator who builds rapport with product, design and business stakeholders.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
